svg.aria-label: AWS architecture: a client resolves DNS via Route 53, reaches the frontend through CloudFront and S3, and the backend API through WAF and an Application Load Balancer into EKS worker nodes running in private subnets across two AZs, which read RDS Postgres, and pull images from ECR through a NAT Gateway. In-cluster Helm-installed controllers (AWS Load Balancer Controller, External Secrets, external-dns), all IRSA-authorized, manage the ALB, sync Secrets Manager, and write DNS records respectively. Everything is encrypted with a per-environment KMS key and monitored via CloudWatch, SNS, CloudTrail, and an IAM permissions boundary.
svg.text: Terraform-managed · one environment shown (dev / qa / prd wire identically — see infra/README.md)
*single shared NAT in dev/qa; one per AZ in prd
Cluster controllers, supporting & account-level services (outside the VPC)
(the first three reuse the ALB / Secrets Manager / Route 53 glyphs above - they're Helm-installed K8s controllers, not those AWS services themselves)
